## Order matters
Vapi gets its answer as soon as **Cal.com + the CRM insert** succeed. Slack, the activity log and the owner SMS hang off the same node and run *after* the response is sent — they must never sit in the caller's latency budget.

`google_calendar_event_id` is deliberately left NULL: Cal.com already syncs to Anthony's Google Calendar, and writing both creates duplicate events.

## Env vars on the n8n service
`CAL_COM_API_KEY`, `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID`, `OWNER_PHONE`.

Select your real **Twilio API Key** basic-auth credential on *Text Anthony*.

**2026-09-08:** this n8n blocks `$env` inside nodes, so Cal.com auth is the *Cal.com API Key (drsqclt)* Header Auth credential (id 6N8Gw12AStkWa9P3) and the Twilio account SID and messaging-service SID are placeholder values that deploy.py injects from env (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID / TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID) and the owner number is a constant. No Railway env vars are read.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
),
args AS (
  SELECT j->>'name' AS name, j->>'phone' AS phone, j->>'address' AS address, j->>'service_type' AS service_type,
         j->>'notes' AS notes, NULLIF(j->>'price', '')::numeric AS price,
         (j->>'appt_date')::date AS appt_date, (j->>'appt_time')::time AS appt_time,
         j->>'cal_uid' AS cal_uid, coalesce((j->>'sms_consent')::boolean, false) AS sms_consent,
         right(regexp_replace(coalesce(j->>'phone', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) AS p10
  FROM p
),
existing AS (
  SELECT c.id FROM squeegee_clients c, args a
  WHERE a.p10 <> '' AND right(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = a.p10
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
inserted_client AS (
  INSERT INTO squeegee_clients (name, phone, address, sms_consent, sms_consent_at, sms_consent_method, sms_consent_note)
  SELECT a.name, a.phone, a.address, a.sms_consent,
         CASE WHEN a.sms_consent THEN now() END,
         CASE WHEN a.sms_consent THEN 'verbal' END,
         CASE WHEN a.sms_consent THEN 'Agreed to texts on a call answered by the after-hours voice agent.' END
  FROM args a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id
),
consented AS (
  UPDATE squeegee_clients c
     SET sms_consent = true,
         sms_consent_at = coalesce(c.sms_consent_at, now()),
         sms_consent_method = coalesce(c.sms_consent_method, 'verbal'),
         sms_consent_note = coalesce(c.sms_consent_note, 'Agreed to texts on a call answered by the after-hours voice agent.')
    FROM args a
   WHERE c.id = (SELECT id FROM existing) AND a.sms_consent AND NOT c.sms_consent
  RETURNING c.id
),
cid AS (SELECT id FROM existing UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_client)
INSERT INTO squeegee_jobs
  (client_name, client_phone, address, service_type, notes, price, status,
   appointment_date, appointment_time, cal_booking_uid, client_id)
SELECT a.name, a.phone, a.address, a.service_type, NULLIF(a.notes, ''), a.price, 'scheduled',
       a.appt_date, a.appt_time, a.cal_uid, (SELECT id FROM cid LIMIT 1)
FROM args a
RETURNING id, client_name, address, service_type, price, appointment_date, appointment_time, client_id;

INSERT INTO squeegee_activity (job_id, type, note)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'booked_by_voice_agent', 'Booked by the after-hours voice agent.');
